text:
I finished my first half marathon in Bengaluru, crossing the line in 2:05:30. 🏃

If I had to sum up the journey in one lesson, it's this: consistency beat motivation.

Motivation showed up some mornings and disappeared on others. What carried me to the finish was simply turning up, again and again, whether I felt like it or not.

A huge thank you to my running group, Sunday Striders, for being part of that routine and for making the miles so much better.

To anyone thinking about a first big goal: don't wait to feel motivated. Start, then keep showing up.

#HalfMarathon #Running #Consistency
